version.changelog:
- Initial release of the LGD Governance Method Suite.
- Provides a bilingual (English & Chinese) playbook for the full AI agent governance lifecycle.
- Orchestrates 9 independently published sub-skills by slug; does not include sub-skill internals.
- Includes documentation and a read-only CLI routing tool for governance, security audits, and release compliance checks.
- Designed for users seeking an end-to-end governance plan, security audit procedure, or release compliance review.

llm.summary: This skill is a documented governance playbook with a small read-only router script, and I found no hidden network, data access, persistence, or action-taking behavior.

dimensions.detail: Allowed tools include Bash for the Python CLI, which is proportionate to the documented command examples. Users should separately evaluate any referenced sub-skills before installing or invoking them.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains SKILL.md, README.md, and one Python CLI router. No installer, dependency fetch, package install, remote payload retrieval, or setup hook was present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to listing the governance flow and showing route notes. The artifact explicitly says it does not vendor sub-skill internals or perform actions on the user's behalf.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, credential handling, background worker, file write, network call, privilege escalation, or system modification was found in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to route users through an AI-agent governance workflow by referencing nine external sub-skills by slug; the bundled script only prints stage, slug, timing, and expected-output guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: This skill appears safe as a read-only governance index. Before using the full workflow, review and install the referenced sub-skills separately because their behavior is not bundled or validated by this package.
